people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hadadezer
people.line: King of Zobah, defeated by David.

people.name: Hamath
people.line: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.

people.name: Toi
people.line: King of Hamath who sent his son to David

people.name: Zobah
people.line: An Aramean kingdom, enemy of Israel during David's reign

translations.web: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
translations.bsb: When King Tou of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
translations.kjv: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
translations.asv: And when Tou king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah,
